changes.title: Shell follows the modern boards: side pane, tool pill, floating phone bar
changes.detail:
Batch 45. The owner looked at build 347 and said it still does not look like the design. Fair: the colours matched, the frame around every page did not. Unit tested only; nothing here has been seen in a browser.

- Wide: one navigation pane is the default, drawn as a floating card on the left with the page as a second card. A choice of "off" is kept. A fresh browser used to land on the top edge because empty saved lists were read as proof of an older version; a stored "top" that nobody chose is returned to the left pane once per browser. - Page top: one floating tool pill instead of a search field and about ten icons. Search this page hides behind a magnifier. - Automation editor: one bar and one Save. Build 347 showed two of each. - Phone: a floating pill bottom bar with Settings where Access was; accessibility tools open from the Menu drawer; one hamburger fewer.

Checks: 291 test files, 3,282 tests passed across components, layouts, panels, tabs, regex, language mode and locks; sync tests 69 passed; type check clean apart from the two known gallery errors.
changes.detail_yue: 第 45 批。屋主睇完 347 話「都唔似設計圖」，講得啱：顏色啱晒，但個殼仲係 舊嗰個。今次換殼：闊螢幕預設一塊浮起嘅側邊窗格，頁面自己一張卡；頁頂 十幾粒圖示收埋做一粒浮動工具藥丸；自動化編輯器由兩條列兩粒儲存掣變返 一條一粒；手機底列變浮動藥丸，設定頂替咗輔助功能個位，輔助功能搬入選單。 以前冇人揀過但係自動寫低嘅「頂部」位置，每個瀏覽器會自動還原一次去左邊。 全部只係單元測試過，未喺瀏覽器睇過。

changes.title: Editor tools from canvas 30, polish from canvases 28 and 29
changes.detail:
Batch 44. Unit tested only; nothing here has been seen in a browser.

- Automation editor: a Tools entry in the editor menu. Flow view with a minimap, trace list, simulator on the existing dry run (it never calls a service and says which conditions it cannot judge), conflict and loop detector, plain language, steps on and off, variable and template inspector, blueprint maker with a snippet library, health score with its formula shown, week ahead, and an entity swap across automations with a review step. - Dashboard editor: screens side by side, grid layout per card, visibility, interactions, style and theme per view, state simulator on a copy of the states, entity inspector, accessibility scan, wall panel (per browser, off by default), card library with versions, redraw time per card, and a diff between named checkpoints. - Polish: PIN keypad, lock wizard and list, personal settings tiles, guided setup cards, notification count, a date range on release notes, timelines in page history and schedules, focus modes as cards, a token swatch grid. - Not built, because nothing real backs them: live breakpoints, replay of a recorded day, test case coverage, free pixel layout. The full list
changes.detail_yue: 第 44 批。畫布 30 嗰廿幾樣編輯器新工具落咗地：自動化有流程圖、追蹤、模擬 （淨係計，絕對唔會真係開你盞燈）、衝突偵測、健康分數、一星期預告；儀表板 有並排睇四種螢幕、狀態模擬、無障礙掃描、掛牆模式、卡片庫同版本對比。 冇真數據撐嘅嘢一律唔起，唔會整啲假數字出嚟呃人。順手執返三個喺 main 度 紅咗嘅粵語測試。全部只係單元測試過，未喺瀏覽器睇過。

changes.title: Modern everyday pages: media browser header, embedded page as cards
changes.detail:
Batch 43, from design canvas 24-modern-everyday. Unit checks only; not seen in a browser.

- Media browser: a large "Media" title with one summary line at the top level. Inside a folder it steps aside so the folder name leads. - Embedded page: the frame, the address bar and the notices sit in rounded cards with spacing instead of running edge to edge. - One new English string for the summary line.

By source reading the history, activity, calendar, to-do, map, profile and maintenance pages already match their boards through the shared theme. Dashboards, energy, climate, lights, security and the first-run pages have not been compared yet.

Checks: type check clean apart from the two known gallery errors; prettier, eslint and the template check pass on both files.
changes.detail_yue: 第 43 批。媒體瀏覽器終於有個大大隻「媒體」標題同一句簡介，入到資料夾 就自動讓位畀資料夾名做主角。內嵌頁面唔再貼到盡，個框、網址列同提示全部 入晒圓角卡片，透返啖氣。其餘日常頁面睇源碼已經跟到塊板，儀表板、能源 嗰批仲未對。只做咗單元檢查，未喺瀏覽器睇過。
